title: 真实group_by变更：一个活动组拆为两个新组，同receiver和告警身份仍集中重发
answer:
```python
import copy,re
def regroup(config,labels):
    if not isinstance(labels,list) or not labels or not all(isinstance(x,str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*",x) for x in labels) or len(set(labels))!=len(labels):raise ValueError("approved unique label names required")
    result=copy.deepcopy(config);result["route"]["group_by"]=list(labels)
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
分组身份改变会建立新的通知组，旧通知历史不一定映射到新组。评估活动告警规模、渠道限流和接收端幂等，安排受控窗口并验证真实影响。

conversion.original_title: 改变group_by后为何可能出现一次集中重发？

body:
## 操作任务
实现regroup(config,labels)：labels须为非空list，含互不重复的普通Prometheus标签名（ASCII字母或下划线起始，其后字母数字下划线），否则ValueError。不接受特殊...。深拷贝配置，仅将根route.group_by替换为独立的labels副本，其他子路由/接收器/计时配置及输入均不变。真实Alertmanager原按service把两台主机告警合成一个组；改为service+instance并在同PID热重载后，观察同一receiver收到两个新的组通知，原两个fingerprint和startsAt不变。说明分组身份变化会让内部去重重新判断，不能把变更后集中通知全当作新故障或通道重试。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1单实例真实调度与通知、私有回环Webhook及同进程重载。不同于receiver更名，本题接收器不变而groupKey改变；未演练HA、业务工单系统或生产变更。只对这个已批准的分组调整给出证据，不保证任意group_by调整的通知量或时间边界。自有短生命周期资源，不构建镜像，不改默认身份或生产配置。

import copy,datetime,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from notifications_fixture import native,receiver,request,wait_for
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-regroup-") as temp,receiver() as (url,seen):
 config={"route":{"receiver":"private","group_by":["service"],"group_wait":"250ms","group_interval":"1s","repeat_interval":"1h","routes":[{"receiver":"other","matchers":["team=other"],"group_by":["alertname"]}]},"receivers":[{"name":"private","webhook_configs":[{"url":url}]},{"name":"other"}]};original=copy.deepcopy(config)
 with native(pathlib.Path(temp)/"native",config) as (base,path,proc):
  now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);alerts=[dict(labels=dict(alertname="PrivateRegroup",service="api",instance=i),annotations=dict(summary="same live incident"),startsAt=now.isoformat(),endsAt=(now+datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()) for i in ["host-a","host-b"]]
  assert request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",alerts)[0]==200;wait_for(lambda:len(seen)>0)
  first=copy.deepcopy(seen[0]);assert len(first["alerts"])==2 and first["groupLabels"]=={"service":"api"};cut=len(seen);pid=proc.pid
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: change actual grouping keys without changing receiver or alert identities",flush=True)
  fixed=task.regroup(config,["service","instance"]);path.write_text(json.dumps(fixed),encoding="utf8")
  assert request("POST",base+"/-/reload")[0]==200;assert request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",alerts)[0]==200
  def split():return {p["groupLabels"].get("instance"):p for p in seen[cut:] if p["groupLabels"].get("instance") in ["host-a","host-b"]}
  wait_for(lambda:len(split())==2);groups=list(split().values())
  assert proc.poll() is None and proc.pid==pid and len({p["groupKey"] for p in groups})==2 and all(p["groupKey"]!=first["groupKey"] for p in groups)
  assert all(p["receiver"]==first["receiver"]=="private" and len(p["alerts"])==1 for p in groups)
  before={(a["fingerprint"],a["startsAt"]) for a in first["alerts"]};after={(a["fingerprint"],a["startsAt"]) for p in groups for a in p["alerts"]};assert before==after
  expected=copy.deepcopy(original);expected["route"]["group_by"]=["service","instance"];assert fixed==expected and config==original
  print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_GROUPBY_CHANGE_ONE_GROUP_TO_TWO_RENOTIFIES_SAME_RECEIVER_FINGERPRINTS_STARTSAT_SAME_PID",flush=True)
  try:task.regroup(config,["service","service"])
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError("duplicate grouping label accepted")
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
